answer_1.quote: In this paper, we make the first exploration of using style transfer in textual adversarial and backdoor attacks.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates adversarial examples and poisoned samples via text style transfer, which involves paraphrase generation while preserving semantics and altering style.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics Following previous work , we thoroughly evaluate adversarial attacks from three perspectives: (1) attack effectiveness, which is measured by attack success rate (ASR)... (2) adversarial example quality, comprising fluency that is measured by perplexity (PPL) given by GPT-2 language model and grammaticality that is measured by grammatical error numbers (GE)...

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the attack validity of different adversarial attacks by human evaluation... Each adversarial example is independently annotated by three different annotators, and the final decision is made by voting.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to make a binary decision on whether each adversarial example has the same sentiment as the original example.
